requests.en:
Diwali shopping for the family. Everything must arrive by 8 November, and items come to our home unless I say otherwise.
For me: the highest-rated sneakers in size UK 8 and red under ₹3,000.
For Mummy: the highest-rated kurti in size S and black under ₹1,500.
Use the coupon that gives the biggest discount.
Pay with my ICICI credit card ending 4471 and choose the morning (9 am - 12 noon) delivery slot.
